changes.evidence: Past employer told on screen: Tilda worked with Doctors Without Borders before founding Mother's Touch (mentioned in Luke Cage S2 episode 11 'For Pete's Sake', where she tells Luke that being in the middle of nowhere got her into holistic medicine; the MCU Wiki's Jackson Dillard page cites episode 7). A past group goes first, keyed to her first title.

K'un-Lun is Bakuto's PAST group (he trained there, perverted its teachings and was banished, then co-founded the Hand), told in Iron Fist S1 episodes 10 and 12. The record puts K'un-Lun after the Hand, keyed to The Defenders, as if he left the Hand for K'un-Lun. He is in the Hand throughout The Defenders, so the past stage goes first at his first title and the Hand is his last stage.

K'un-Lun is Sowande's PAST group: he trained there and was banished with the other Fingers, who then formed the Hand (The Defenders episode 4). The record has a Hand stage before K'un-Lun, as if he was in the Hand first. The past group goes first, then the Hand.

Two fixes. (1) Missing past group: in Daredevil: Born Again S1 episode 6 ('Excessive Force') Fisk reads North's record: born and raised in Chicago, a Chicago police officer whose excessive-force incident marked his record before he moved to the NYPD in 2011. (2) The leading 'Fisk's Empire' stage starts too early: North was an NYPD cop who killed Hector Ayala on his own (episode 3, egged on by Powell); he first serves Fisk when Fisk recruits him into the Anti-Vigilante Task Force in episode 6. The rest of the record is kept as it is.

Order is wrong twice. (1) Garrett joined S.H.I.E.L.D. first (a top recruit under Fury, shown as a young S.H.I.E.L.D. trainee in 1983 in S7 episode 10 'Stolen'), was recruited into HYDRA after S.H.I.E.L.D. left him for dead in Sarajevo (c. 1990), and only later masterminded Centipede. The record has HYDRA then Centipede BEFORE S.H.I.E.L.D., as if he left Centipede to join S.H.I.E.L.D. (2) In S7 episode 10 the young S.H.I.E.L.D. trainee Garrett is recruited by Nathaniel Malick at the Krazy Kanoe bar and turns on S.H.I.E.L.D.; he serves Malick's crew until Victoria Hand kills him. The record ends on S.H.I.E.L.D. after Malick's crew; the last stage should be Nathaniel Malick's Crew.

Project Centipede is out of order. Garrett recruited Ward into HYDRA in 1999 and sent him into the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy; Ward only works alongside Garrett's Centipede operation in S1 (after the HYDRA reveal in episode 17). The record puts Centipede before S.H.I.E.L.D., as if he left Centipede to join S.H.I.E.L.D. The rest stays as it is.

Past employer told on screen: in The Punisher S1 episode 8 ('Cold Steel') Rawlins' background is given: after Harvard he worked for the family business, Rawlins Logistics Corp, before the CIA recruited him. A past group goes first, keyed to his first title.

owner_calls.question: Pilgrim has no groups. Two open questions apply: (a) his old gang (the Aryans / Aryan Brotherhood, held: 'Pilgrim's old gang'), and (b) his forced service for Anderson and Eliza Schultz, who hold his sons' safety over him. Does serving the Schultzes count as a group (their company is Testament Industries, which the dataset does not track), and under what name?
options: Add the old gang as a past stage (Punisher S2) with a left, and nothing for the Schultzes
Also add a stage for the Schultzes (e.g. 'The Schultzes' or Testament Industries) from The Punisher S2
owner_calls.evidence: The Punisher S2 episode 9: Kusack and Danny recall Robert as a member of their gang; he says the Schultzes found him in jail and he turned his back on it. Through S2 he kills for the Schultzes because they control his family; in the finale Frank spares him and the Schultzes die.

owner_calls.question: Lewis attends Curtis Hoyle's veterans' group therapy sessions at St. John's church in The Punisher S1 (episodes 1 to 3) and then quits them (episode 4, 'Resupply'). If the open question on Curtis's veterans' support group goes 'it counts', should Lewis get that stage too? His last stage stays Independent either way, since he quits it.
options: Add 'New York Veteran Support Group' after U.S. Army at The Punisher S1, keeping Independent and the left
Leave as is (attending therapy sessions isn't membership)
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU Wiki lists New York Veteran Support Group (formerly). He also tries to join Anvil in episode 4, but Russo turns him down, so Anvil is not a group for him.
